in_arabic.name: Mujeedan
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mujeedan هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'ajd, meaning 'to praise'. The name Mujeedan signifies one who is worthy of praise and admiration. In Islamic tradition, this name is often given to girls who are believed to possess virtuous and noble character traits.
